products.name: Modern Kitenge Blazer & Trousers Set
products.nameFr: Ensemble Veste et Pantalon en Kitenge Moderne
products.nameSw: Suti ya Kitenge ya Kisasa na Suruali
products.description: Authentic premium Rwandan Kitenge tailored blazer with matching tapered trousers. Handcrafted by local artisans in Rwamagana.
products.descriptionRw: Ikoti n’ipantalo bikozwe mu gitenge cyiza cy’umwimerere bitunganijwe n’abadozi b’inzobere i Rwamagana.
products.descriptionFr: Ensemble élégant cousu main à Rwamagana avec du tissu Kitenge rwandais de haute qualité.
products.descriptionSw: Suti ya kitenge iliyotengenezwa kwa ustadi mjini Rwamagana kwa kitambaa bora cha Kiafrika.

products.name: Traditional Rwandan Umushanana Ceremonial Dress
products.nameSw: Nguo ya Jadi ya Kinyarwanda ya Sherehe (Umushanana)
products.description: Exquisite ceremonial Umushanana attire for weddings and cultural celebrations. Silky drape with matching sash and undergarment.
products.descriptionRw: Umushanana mwiza cyane w’ibirori n’ubukwe, ukozwe mu mwenda unyerera woroheye umubiri.
products.descriptionFr: Tenue traditionnelle rwandaise Umushanana d’une élégance rare pour les réceptions.
products.descriptionSw: Mavazi ya asili ya Rwanda yenye heshima na mvuto mkubwa kwa sherehe za harusi.

products.name: Rwanda Heritage Casual Cotton Hoodie
products.nameFr: Sweat à Capuche Coton Héritage Rwanda
products.nameSw: Hoodie ya Pamba ya Urithi wa Rwanda
products.description: Heavyweight organic cotton hoodie with discreet embroidery inspired by Rwandan Imigongo geometric art patterns.
products.descriptionRw: Umupira w’ipamba ukomeye ufite ibishushanyo by’imigongo by’umuco nyarwanda birinda imbeho.
products.descriptionFr: Sweat à capuche chaud en coton bio orné de motifs géométriques Imigongo.
products.descriptionSw: Sweta nzito ya pamba yenye nembo ya mchoro wa Imigongo ya Rwanda.

products.name: Handcrafted Rwandan Leather Loafers
products.nameFr: Mocassins en Cuir Véritable Faits Main au Rwanda
products.nameSw: Viatu vya Ngozi Halisi Vilivyotengenezwa kwa Mkono
products.description: Full-grain cow leather loafers hand-stitched by Rwandan cobblers. Cushioned insole for all-day comfort.
products.descriptionRw: Inkweto z’uruhu nyarwanda rw’inka zikomeye kandi zifite imbere horoshye cyane.
products.descriptionFr: Mocassins en cuir pleine fleur, semelle souple pour un confort durable.
products.descriptionSw: Viatu imara vya ngozi kwa ajili ya ofisi na shughuli rasmi.

products.name: AirFlex High-Performance Running Sneakers
products.nameRw: Inkweto za Siporo za AirFlex zoroheye ibirenge
products.description: Lightweight breathable mesh athletic shoes with shock absorption sole.
products.descriptionRw: Inkweto za siporo zikomeye kandi zoroheje zifasha mu kwiruka no kugenda.
products.descriptionFr: Chaussures de sport ultra-légères à amorti dynamique pour la course.
products.descriptionSw: Viatu vyepesi vya michezo vyenye kuzuia mishtuko.

products.name: Chic Block-Heel Strappy Sandals
products.nameSw: Sandali za Kisasa za Kike Zenye Kisigino
products.description: Comfortable 2.5-inch block heel sandals with delicate straps and ankle buckle.
products.descriptionRw: Inkweto z’abategarugori ziberanye n’ibirori n’amasengesho, zifite agatsinsino gafashe neza.
products.descriptionFr: Sandales confortables à talon bloc de 6 cm, bride réglable à la cheville.
products.descriptionSw: Sandali maridadi za kisigino kifupi zinazofaa mikusanyiko yote.

products.name: Traditional Agaseke Handwoven Sisal Tote Bag
products.nameFr: Sac Cabas Tissé à la Main en Sisal Traditionnel Agaseke
products.nameSw: Mkoba wa Asili wa Kusuka wa Agaseke
products.description: Iconic Rwandan Agaseke geometric woven tote crafted by Eastern Province women cooperatives with sisal and sweetgrass fibers with sturdy leather handles.
products.descriptionRw: Igisakoshi cy’agaseke kibohesheje ubugwegwe n’amasekeje n’abagore bo mu Ntara y’Iburasirazuba.
products.descriptionFr: Magnifique sac artisanal en sisal et herbes douces, fabriqué par les coopératives féminines du Rwanda.
products.descriptionSw: Mkoba wa asili uliofumwa kwa mikono na vikundi vya wanawake wa Rwanda.

products.name: Executive Waterproof Laptop Backpack (15.6")
products.nameRw: Igisakoshi cyo mu mugongo cya mudasobwa kirinda amazi
products.nameFr: Sac à Dos Ordinateur Professionnel Imperméable
products.nameSw: Begi la Mgongoni la Laptop Linalozuia Maji
products.description: Water-resistant Oxford fabric backpack with padded compartment for 15.6-inch laptop, USB charging port passthrough, and anti-theft back pocket.
products.descriptionRw: Igisakoshi cyo mu mugongo kigenewe mudasobwa kirinda amazi, gifite umwanya wa charger na porotegisiyo yo kutibwa.
products.descriptionFr: Sac à dos imperméable avec compartiment matelassé pour ordinateur et port USB intégré.
products.descriptionSw: Begi imara la laptop lenye mfumo wa kuzuia wizi na tundu la kuchajia simu.

products.name: Elegant Quilted Vegan Leather Crossbody
products.nameFr: Sac Bandoulière Matelassé en Cuir Végan
products.nameSw: Mkoba Mdogo wa Kupasua wa Kike
products.description: Compact daily purse featuring diamond quilting, gold chain strap, and secure magnetic flap.
products.descriptionRw: Igisakoshi cyiza gifite umunyororo wa zahabu kibika neza telefoni n’ibikoresho by’ubwiza.
products.descriptionFr: Sac bandoulière élégant avec chaîne dorée et fermeture aimantée sécurisée.
products.descriptionSw: Mkoba mwepesi na wa kuvutia wenye mnyororo wa dhahabu.

products.name: Rapid-Boil Stainless Steel Electric Kettle (1.8L)
products.nameFr: Bouilloire Électrique Inox à Ébullition Rapide 1,8L
products.nameSw: Kettli ya Umeme ya Chuma cha Pua (Lita 1.8)
products.description: 1500W fast boiling kettle with 304 food-grade stainless steel interior and automatic shut-off safety.
products.descriptionRw: Itegure ry’amashanyarazi ritekera amazi ku munota umwe, rikikupa igihe amazi abize.
products.descriptionFr: Bouilloire 1500W en inox avec arrêt automatique et protection contre l’ébullition à sec.
products.descriptionSw: Kettli yenye nguvu ya kuchemsha maji haraka na usalama wa kujizima.

products.name: Multi-Blade Kitchen Blender & Spice Grinder (1000W)
products.nameFr: Mixeur Blender Multifonction & Moulin à Épices
products.nameSw: Blenda ya Jikoni yenye Nguvu na Kusaga Viungo
products.description: Heavy duty 1000W electric blender with glass jug and dry mill attachment.
products.descriptionRw: Blender ikomeye ifite ikirahure gikomeye isya imbuto z’umutobe, ibirungo na kawa.
products.descriptionFr: Blender puissant avec bol en verre trempé et moulin sec pour smoothies et épices.
products.descriptionSw: Blenda ya glasi imara ya kusaga juisi safi, kahawa na viungo vya chakula.

products.name: Granite Non-Stick 4-Piece Frying & Pot Cookware Set
products.nameRw: Amasafuriya y’amasahani meza arambye arinda gufata (Piece 4)
products.nameFr: Batterie de Cuisine 4 Pièces Antiadhésive Granit
products.nameSw: Seti ya Vyombo vya Kupikia visivyoshika Chakula
products.description: Induction-ready eco-friendly granite stone coating pots and pan set with tempered glass lids.
products.descriptionRw: Amasafuriya meza adafatisha ibiryo, akoreshwa ku ziko ry’amashanyarazi cyangwa gaze.
products.descriptionFr: Ensemble de poêles et casseroles en granit sans PFOA pour une cuisson saine.
products.descriptionSw: Sufuria za kisasa zisizoungua zinazofaa gesi na majiko ya umeme.

products.name: Artisanal Ankole Cow Horn & Brass Bangles (Set of 3)
products.nameRw: Imikufi y’amaboko ikoze mu mahembe y’Inyambo n’umuringa
products.nameFr: Bracelets Artisanaux en Corne d’Ankole et Laiton
products.nameSw: Bangili za Asili za Pembe za Ng’ombe na Shaba
products.description: Hand-polished upcycled Rwandan Ankole cattle horn bangles accented with reclaimed gold brass inlays.
products.descriptionRw: Imikufi y’amaboko ikoze mu mahembe y’inyambo z’i Rwanda n’umuringa wa zahabu, irimbisha amaboko cyane.
products.descriptionFr: Trio de bracelets faits à la main avec de la corne d’Ankole naturelle polie et inserts en laiton.
products.descriptionSw: Bangili za kuvutia zilizong’arishwa zikichanganya pembe za ng’ombe na madini ya shaba.

products.name: 18K Gold Plated Sunburst Drop Earrings
products.nameRw: Amaherena ya zahabu ya 18K meza cyane arimbisha
products.description: Hypoallergenic lightweight drop earrings inspired by the radiant sun on the National Flag of Rwanda.
products.descriptionRw: Amaherena meza afite isura y’izuba ryo ku ibendera ry’u Rwanda, atangiza amatwi kandi adapfa kwandura.
products.descriptionFr: Boucles d’oreilles hypoallergéniques inspirées du soleil rwandais avec finition anti-ternissement.
products.descriptionSw: Hereni nyepesi zisizouza masikio zenye mchoro wa miale ya jua.

products.name: Hand-Beaded Rwandan Choker & Collar Necklace
products.nameRw: Urukufi rw’amasaro y’umuco nyarwanda mu ijosi
products.nameFr: Collier Ras-du-Cou Traditionnel Perlé à la Main
products.nameSw: Mkufu wa Shanga za Jadi za Rwanda
products.description: Intricately strung glass beads forming traditional geometric motifs with adjustable clasp.
products.descriptionRw: Urukufi rwiza rw’amasaro y’amabara y’umuco nyarwanda rujya mu ijosi rikaryoherwa.
products.descriptionFr: Collier ras-du-cou minutieusement tissé de perles de verre par les femmes de Rwamagana.
products.descriptionSw: Mkufu wa shanga za rangi za kupendeza unalingana vizuri shingoni.

products.name: Pure Organic Rwandan Avocado Glow Facial Oil (50ml)
products.nameRw: Amavuta y’umwimerere ya Avoka yo kwisiga mu maso (50ml)
products.nameFr: Huile Visage Éclat Bio à l’Avocat du Rwanda (50ml)
products.nameSw: Mafuta Asilia ya Parachichi ya Usoni (50ml)
products.description: Cold-pressed 100% unrefined avocado oil harvested from Rwamagana and Eastern Province organic farms.
products.descriptionRw: Amavuta y’avoka z’i Rwamagana zikandwa n’imashini zikonje, asukura uruhu kandi akarinda gusaza.
products.descriptionFr: Huile d’avocat pressée à froid issue des vergers de l’Est du Rwanda, riche en vitamine E et omégas.
products.descriptionSw: Mafuta halisi ya parachichi yanayorutubisha ngozi na kuifanya ing’ae bila kemikali.

products.name: Whipped Shea & Cocoa Deep Nourishing Body Butter (250g)
products.nameRw: Amavuta y’amavuta ya Shea n’Ingano yo gusiga umubiri wose (250g)
products.nameSw: Siagi ya Mwili ya Shea na Kakao (250g)
products.description: Ultra-creamy body lotion scented with warm vanilla and sweet almond.
products.descriptionRw: Amavuta yoroshya umubiri cyane akumara amasaha 48 adakakaye, anuka neza cyane.
products.descriptionFr: Beurre ultra-nourrissant au beurre de karité pour 48 heures d’hydratation intense.
products.descriptionSw: Mafuta ya kupaka mwili yanayolinda ukavu wa ngozi kwa saa 48 na harufu nzuri.

products.name: Clear Mineral Invisible Sunscreen SPF 50+ (75ml)
products.nameRw: Amavuta arinda imirasire y’izuba SPF 50+ adasiga ibara ryera
products.nameSw: Mafuta ya Kuzuia Mionzi Mikali ya Jua SPF 50+
products.description: Broad spectrum UVA/UVB non-greasy sunscreen formulated specially for melanin-rich skin with zero white cast.
products.descriptionRw: Amavuta arinda uruhu gutwikwa n’izuba ry’u Rwanda, adasiga ibara ryera mu maso.
products.descriptionFr: Protection solaire invisible haute performance SPF 50+ sans résidu blanc sur peaux foncées.
products.descriptionSw: Mafuta ya kulinda jua yasiyoacha weupe wowote usoni.
